records.reason: Develop substantive Earth and environmental science coverage on its own scientific merits, including Earth-system processes, observation and supporting evidence. Sensor networks, environmental time series, calibration, data assimilation, uncertainty and simulation are relevant methodological connections, not admission requirements.
records.notes: Research priority; not an automatic Domain approval.

records.reason: Strong fit with BITwiki itself: information, libraries, knowledge representation, and semantic systems.
records.notes: Wave 2 established substantial ontology, semantics, metadata, knowledge-representation, knowledge-graph, and Semantic Web foundations.
